facts.fact: Sorsha 给她的性自由只有一条铁律：卫兵不许进入——她要的是一个可出售的「技术处女」。
facts.anchor: they were never allowed to penetrate me

facts.fact: 父亲身份揭底：Nikos Ironwood，已覆灭的 Ironwood pack 三子；母亲从不提他。
facts.anchor: She never spoke of Nikos Ironwood, the third son of the now decimated Ironwood pack.

facts.fact: 母亲要的是地位与肚子里的幼崽来巩固权力；她出生前 Nikos 已因无用被弃。
facts.anchor: before I was born Nikos lost his usefulness

facts.fact: 她恨他的温柔——他必须当怪物，她才能无愧地把丈夫当工具使。
facts.anchor: So I could use him like a tool without a single flicker of hesitation or guilt.

facts.fact: 今夜必须圆房：没有落红母亲就会起疑，伪装与整盘陷阱会开局前崩塌。
facts.anchor: if there was no blood on the sheets, my mother would know

facts.fact: 她宁可被劈成两半也不许失败——莽汉不认领她，她就认领他。
facts.anchor: If the brute wasn't going to claim me, I would claim him.

facts.fact: 反转高潮：她扑上去咬穿他颈肩交界处，用认领咬痕标记了丈夫。
facts.anchor: as I marked my husband with a claiming bite
